units.source_text: 趁着不安还没有深入内心，也算休息一下，他决定先做个洞穴模型来确认一下。

en.t: Before the uneasiness had sunk too deeply into him, and partly as a way to take a break, he decided first to make a model of the hole and check it.
After all, there was no shortage of material.

units.source_text: 他挑了屋檐下的一片阴凉地，挖了个五十厘米大小的坑。

en.t: He chose a shady spot under the eaves and dug a hole about fifty centimeters across.

units.source_text: 可是，不知为什么，侧面的坡度老是达不到预想的角度。

en.t: But for some reason, the slope of the sides never reached the angle he had expected.

units.source_text: 最多只有四十五度……平口研钵的程度。

en.t: At most it was only forty-five degrees, about the slope of a shallow mortar.

units.source_text: 他再从底下掏挖，沙子沿着斜面滑落，那坡度却依然原封不动。

en.t: When he dug farther from the bottom, the sand slid down along the slanting surface, but the angle itself remained exactly the same.

units.source_text: 看来沙子有一种稳定的角度。

en.t: It seemed that sand had a certain angle of stability.

units.source_text: 粒子的重量与阻力正好取得了平衡吧。

en.t: The weight of the grains and their resistance must have reached just the right balance.

units.source_text: 要真这样的话，那么现在他正挑战的这堵墙壁，也该是这种角度的倾斜吧？

en.t: If that was really so, then the wall he was challenging now should also be slanting at that same angle, should it not?
